Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Each submission hangs on the river of a task receipt, and the terrace is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
